articles.summary: BP (LSE:BP.) is in talks to sell a stake in the offshore Bumerangue oil block in Brazil to Petrobras. The discussions focus on Petrobras taking a partner role in the Bumerangue field, which lies in Brazilian deepwater acreage. The negotiations could reshape BP's portfolio exposure in Brazil if a Bumerangue stake sale to Petrobras goes ahead. articles.summary: Investing.com -- BP PLC (NYSE:BP) is reportedly evaluating a potential exit from its majority stake and operatorship in the Greater Tortue Ahmeyim (GTA) liquefied natural gas facility off the coast of West Africa, according to a Bloomberg report.
